definitions.explanation: An adult male human. Also used as a prefix to indicate male gender of various things.

examples.notes: 男の人 is more polite than 男 alone

examples.english: There are two boys and one girl.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男|おとこ}⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けます→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: He is a manly person and always helps people in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男|おとこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦きています→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: There are many men in this job, but recently women are also increasing.
Boys like playing outside, and girls like drawing pictures at home.

notes:
{男|おとこ} means man or male.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {男|おとこ}: man (neutral/casual)
- {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}: man (polite)
- {男性|だんせい}: male (formal/official)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}: boy
- {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}: man (polite reference)
- {男|おとこ}らしい: manly, masculine
- {男|おとこ}{友達|ともだち}: male friend

READINGS:
- おとこ: standalone word
- だん/なん: in compounds ({男性|だんせい}, {男子|だんし})

CONTRAST:
- {男|おとこ}: man
- {女|おんな}: woman
- {男性|だんせい}: male (formal)
- {女性|じょせい}: female (formal)
